content_units: Best Laptop Value for CS Coursework Under $1,100

For your priorities—  battery life, coding, portability, and staying upgrade-free for a while  —the   Lenovo IdeaPad   is the best overall value. It gives you the strongest balance of   performance, 16GB RAM, low weight, and price headroom  .
Side-by-Side Value Comparison
Model   Price   CPU   RAM   Storage   Screen / Weight   Best For   Main Trade-off
Lenovo IdeaPad     $899     Ryzen 7     16GB     512GB SSD   14" /   1.4 kg     Best value for coding + portability   Less storage than Dell
Dell Inspiron   $1,049   Intel i7     16GB       1TB SSD     15.6" / 1.8 kg   Large screen + more local storage   Heavier, less portable
ASUS Vivobook   $699   Intel i5   8GB   512GB SSD   15" / 1.7 kg   Lowest upfront cost   8GB RAM may age quickly
MacBook Air M2   $1,099   Apple M2   8GB   256GB SSD   13.6" /   1.24 kg     Excellent battery + portability   RAM/storage are limiting at this price
Ranked Recommendation
Option 1:   Lenovo IdeaPad     Best overall value for CS students; strong CPU, 16GB RAM, portable chassis     Best balance under budget

Why the Lenovo IdeaPad Wins
-   Battery life:   While the MacBook Air M2 is likely best here, the Lenovo should still be solid and avoids the memory/storage compromise.
-   Coding performance:   A   Ryzen 7 + 16GB RAM   is a strong setup for IDEs, browser tabs, Docker, light VMs, Python, Java, and typical CS workloads.
-   Portability:   At   1.4 kg  , it is much easier to carry daily than the Dell.
-   Upgrade-free longevity:     16GB RAM   matters more than small CPU differences for staying comfortable over the next few years.
Trade-Off Assessment for Your Priorities
-   Best pure battery/portability:   MacBook Air M2
-   Best coding longevity under budget:   Lenovo IdeaPad
-   Best if you need lots of local storage now:   Dell Inspiron
-   Best if minimizing cost is the top goal:   ASUS Vivobook
Final pick
Choose the Lenovo IdeaPad at $899.

It is the best value because it meets all four priorities better than the others   without overspending  . The MacBook Air M2 is attractive for battery life, but   8GB RAM and 256GB SSD at $1,099   make it a weaker long-term value for CS coursework.
